subject.title: feat(computer-use): control macOS nodes via screenshots and input injection

question: Should OpenClaw bundle this macOS computer-use executor now, and what live-proof/security gate is required before merge?
rationale: This PR intentionally gives agents guarded control over a real desktop through OpenClaw.app-held TCC permissions, which is a product/security boundary that automated review cannot approve from unit tests alone.

options.title: Require live Mac proof first
options.body: Keep the PR open until the keymap bug is fixed and maintainers see redacted proof from a signed Mac covering permissions, arming or approval, click/type actions, and post-action screenshot feedback.

options.title: Split the stack
options.body: Land or reject the metadata-only manifest contract first, then review the macOS executor as a separate security-sensitive PR.

options.title: Move executor out of core
options.body: Pause or close the bundled executor and keep Computer Use as an external plugin path until the host contract and trust boundary stabilize.

recommendation.title: Require live Mac proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the keymap bug is fixed and maintainers see redacted proof from a signed Mac covering permissions, arming or approval, click/type actions, and post-action screenshot feedback.

likelyOwner.reason: They own this stacked PR and recently touched the adjacent gateway approval path, making them the best available decision owner for the merge gate.
